component.name: Custom Media Player
component.summary: Play images, video and audio from your own disk

description.p: A minimal full-screen media player. Drop images, video or audio onto the window and play them through as a playlist.
Nothing is uploaded and nothing leaves the machine. Files stay where they are, and the playlist, your position in it and your settings are remembered between sessions.
Available in English and Arabic, with a right-to-left interface.
